name: Maze

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Banish a creature into a labyrinth; it escapes with a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check as a Study action.
text: No save: the target vanishes into a maze on a demiplane until it escapes or the spell ends. It then returns to the space it left, or the nearest free one.
